ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The graph of f on [0,7] is piecewise linear. It lies above the t-axis for t values before 3, crosses the t-axis at t=3, and lies below the t-axis for t values after 3 on the shown interval. Reasoning: Given G(x)=∫_2^{3x-1} f(t) dt, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus with the chain rule gives G'(x)=3f(3x-1). Since the factor 3 is positive, G' changes from positive to negative exactly when f(3x-1) changes from positive to negative. From the graph, f changes from positive to negative at t=3. So set 3x-1=3, giving 3x=4 and x=4/3. Therefore G has a local maximum at x=4/3.

method.method_draft: Read the graph: f is above the t-axis for t<3, crosses the axis at t=3, and is below the axis for t>3 on the shown interval. Read the text: G(x)=∫_2^{3x-1} f(t)dt. A local maximum of G occurs where G' changes from positive to negative, so we need 3x-1 to be the t-value where f changes sign from + to -, namely t=3. Solve 3x-1=3 to get x=4/3.

method.method_draft: Read the graph: f(t) is positive from t=2 up to t=3, then negative for t>3 on the displayed graph. Read the text: G(x)=∫_2^{3x-1} f(t)dt. Use an accumulation/area argument instead of differentiating: as x increases, the upper limit 3x-1 moves to the right, so G keeps increasing while the added slices of area are positive; once 3x-1 passes t=3, the added slices are negative and G starts decreasing. Therefore G has its local maximum exactly when the upper limit reaches t=3. Solve 3x-1=3, giving x=4/3.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中给出 f 在 [0,7] 上的图像。曲线从左侧上升到约 t=2 处的正值，然后下降并在 t=3 处穿过 t 轴；在 t>3 后图像位于 t 轴下方。因此从图像可读出，f(t) 在 t=2 到 t=3 之间为正，在 t>3 后为负。推理：G(x)=∫_2^{3x-1} f(t)dt。随着 x 增大，上限 3x-1 向右移动；当上限还在 t=2 到 t=3 之间时，新增加的面积对应 f(t)>0，所以 G 增大；当上限超过 t=3 后，新增加的面积对应 f(t)<0，所以 G 减小。因此 G 的局部最大值出现在上限正好到达 t=3 时。解 3x-1=3，得 x=4/3。
